product: MeBook (mebook.ai) personalised picture books, digital or printed; competitor of LumeBook. Shown: printed hardcover books and the website ordering screens (photo crop, theme pick, cover pick, text editing).
disclosure_visible: caption: 'בשיתוף ממומן @mebook.ai'; paid_partnership_label=0 on 15 Oct 2026; no disclosure text on screen
format: sponsored explainer montage: illustrated book covers, screen recording of the ordering steps, real children opening and reading the books, voiceover with burned-in subtitles

hook_0_3s.opening_image: A printed book with an illustrated boy in a cardboard-box space scene lying on a wooden table, with the 'MeBook' logo and 'ספר בהתאמה אישית' text on top; at 1 s a cut to a real toddler in bed with a book; at 2 s the illustrated cover of a girl with animals.
hook_0_3s.spoken: 0.0-4.0 s machine transcript: 'קבלו רעיון למתנה המושלמת, ספר שבו ילדיכם הם גיבורי עלילה.'
hook_0_3s.on_screen_text: 'MeBook' with 'ספר בהתאמה אישית'; 'קבלו רעיון למתנה ה-' (partly cut); 'ספר שבו ילדיכם הם גיבורי העלילה'; book title on the cover partly rotated and unreadable
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: names the brand and the gift idea at once and promises 'your child is the hero', with illustrated covers and a real child in the first 2 s.

how_value_is_shown: Spoken and written: your child is the hero of the story; a three step screen recording (upload a photo, pick a theme, wait a few minutes) followed by children reading the finished book.
demonstration: Screen recording of the ordering steps and the story editor; children opening, turning and reading printed books.
proof: Child using it (several children reading in bed) and the creator claim that the illustration is 'very similar' to the child; no numbers or before/after side by side shown in the frames (not verified).
emotion: Warmth and family memory; excited gift tone.
personal_story: none (the creator does not speak about her own child in the transcript beyond the claim that it is worth it; the children in the videos are not identified)
selling_language: 'המתנה המושלמת'; 'תוך דקות ספורות הקסם נוצר'; 'שווה הכל'; 'זיכרון משפחתי שיישאר איתכם לשנים רבות' (on screen); caption: 'להטבה שווה רשמו בתגובה'
captions_on_screen: burned-in subtitles of speech: bold white or yellow Hebrew with outline, two to three lines in the middle or lower third, changing every 2 to 3 s; sparkle and wand effect at 6 s; headline text boxes at the end
editing_rhythm: Detected 33 cuts in 33.6 s (about 1 s per shot); fast montage, effects and zooms on the illustrated images, screen recordings of 6 to 12 s in the middle; real-child footage in the last third.
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: family reading in bed, then an illustrated girl with bunnies with the text 'לפרטים נוספים והטבה שווה קפצו לתיאור' and down arrows. Caption: comment the word 'מיבוק' to get a coupon code by message; sponsored post label in caption.
price_or_code: No price. Caption: write a comment word ('מיבוק') to receive a coupon code in a message.
convincing: Interpretation: the three-step screen recording shows the effort is small; real children reading and the illustrated covers together make the promise concrete; the comment-word offer turns viewers into leads (574 comments on 15 Oct 2026, a public count that may include the word).
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: very fast cuts, mixed illustrated stock-like images and heavy captions feel like an ad rather than a creator's own experience; no personal story and several different children, so it reads as a template.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: the comment-a-word coupon DM funnel is the repeatable mechanic; a phone-only version is a screen recording of the order steps plus 2 or 3 shots of real pages in a hand, and the one-line 'your child is the hero' hook in the first 3 s.
solo_without_child: yes: the screen recording, covers and pages can be filmed without a child; the reaction shots would need one
not_verified: Whether the 'AI' wording is spoken as the transcript shows (it is also in on-screen text); the exact coupon code; whether music plays; the children's relationship to the creator; the machine transcript has gaps between 26 and 30 s.
